strings.notes: 学夫 not in 0719; US contact Schoolboy Alan (US 0689)

strings.zh: 我喜欢在走路时{NEWLINE}低头看书,有时{CLEAR}会捡到好东西！{SCROLL}对了！下次我再{NEWLINE}捡到的话给你好了！{CLEAR}你能把你电话号码给我吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: When I’m reading textbooks and walking,{NEWLINE}I have to look down, so I notice items{CLEAR}on the ground.{SCROLL}Next time I find something, I’ll give it{NEWLINE}to you.{SCROLL}May I have your phone number? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 找到好东西的话我会打电话{NEWLINE}联系你的,你就等我好消息吧！
strings.en: I’ll call you as soon as I find{NEWLINE}something. You can count on it!

strings.zh: 我还想在看书看腻的时候{NEWLINE}给你打个电话,{CLEAR}害我白高兴一场。
strings.en: And I was hoping to call you{NEWLINE}whenever I got tired of studying.{CLEAR}Guess I got my hopes up for nothing.

strings.zh: 我找到什么东西的话会送给你的,{NEWLINE}所以能把你的电话号码给我吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: If I find something, it’s yours.{NEWLINE}So may I have your phone number? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 这个这个！这个给你！{NEWLINE}请收下！{SCROLL}
strings.en: This, this! This is yours! Ta-da!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 哎？{NEWLINE}莫非你就在附近？{SCROLL}是我低头看书{NEWLINE}没有注意到吗？
strings.en: Huh? Wait, are you nearby?{SCROLL}Did I miss you because I{NEWLINE}had my nose in a book?

strings.zh: 我的{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}变得越来越强了！{CLEAR}这一切都在我的计算之内！{SCROLL}对了,前不久我把{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}打败了！{SCROLL}这对我的学习很有用！{SCROLL}再见啦！
strings.en: My {VAR:0100:10}’s getting stronger,{NEWLINE}exactly as I calculated!{SCROLL}By the way, we knocked out a{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11} the other day.{SCROLL}It was really useful for my studies! See{NEWLINE}you later!
strings.notes: US 0689/7 | RV072: meaning: battle helped his studies (D-1901)

strings.zh: 我的{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}变得越来越强了！{CLEAR}这一切都在我的计算之内！{SCROLL}对了,昨天被{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}给跑掉了。{SCROLL}这可不在我的计算之内。{SCROLL}拜拜！
strings.en: My {VAR:0100:10}’s getting stronger,{NEWLINE}exactly as I calculated!{SCROLL}By the way, a wild {VAR:0100:11} escaped{NEWLINE}on me yesterday.{SCROLL}A computational error on my part...{SCROLL}See you later!

strings.zh: 我现在又学会了很多,{NEWLINE}比上次厉害多了！{SCROLL}你来{VAR:0104:3}{NEWLINE}和我对战一场吧！
strings.en: I’ve studied quite a bit since then, and{NEWLINE}I’ve gotten a lot better!{SCROLL}I’m hanging out on {VAR:0104:3}.{NEWLINE}Can you come down for a battle?

strings.zh: 你再不来对战的话,{NEWLINE}我都要忘了我的策略了！{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3}{NEWLINE}等你！
strings.en: If we don’t battle soon,{NEWLINE}I’ll forget my strategy!{SCROLL}I’m waiting on {VAR:0104:3}!

strings.zh: 嗯,我现在还没有{NEWLINE}发现什么东西⋯⋯{SCROLL}我发现了会联系你的。
strings.en: I haven’t picked up anything yet.{NEWLINE}I’ll call you if I find something.

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,{NEWLINE}我刚才捡到好东西了！{SCROLL}送给你吧！{NEWLINE}你能来{VAR:0104:3}{CLEAR}拿吗？
strings.en: Heh heh. I found something really{NEWLINE}awesome earlier!{SCROLL}I’ll give it to you. Can you come to{NEWLINE}{VAR:0104:3} and pick it up?

strings.zh: 我还要做作业呢,{NEWLINE}所以拜托你快点！{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3}{NEWLINE}等你！
strings.en: I have to do my homework, so can you{NEWLINE}come get your gift right away?{SCROLL}I’m waiting on {VAR:0104:3}!
